$comment: Public, non-secret Robinhood Chain Mainnet deployment identity for clog.run. Tracked in git deliberately - see docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md for why (this exists specifically so a stale .env.production on the VPS can never silently override which deployment the frontend reads from after a git pull). Contains ONLY public contract addresses, chain id, and deployment block - never secrets, never a database URL, never a signer key. Edit this file (and only this file) to point the frontend at a different deployment; no other source file should ever hardcode a contract address.

$notReadByFrontend.$comment: Recorded for operational completeness and for scripts/verify-deployment.sh's own cross-contract checks. Never read by the Next.js app itself - see POST_DEPLOY_HANDOFF.md for exactly which five addresses (plus chainId/deploymentBlock) the frontend actually uses.

$verification.$comment: NOT independently verified on-chain as of this file's creation - see docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md. Run scripts/verify-deployment.sh against a real RPC endpoint before treating this file as trustworthy, and fill in deploymentBlock (above, currently null) from its output before pointing clog.run at this deployment.
